content.comment_body: Our computers have been upgraded to Windows 10. We installed [product_name] on each machine, but now we're unable to connect to the [product_name] controller.

Which [product_name] [article_no] version do you have? Is it [article_no] Standard (FS01-FS03), or [product_name] FS04 (FS04-FS05)? What version of [product_name] software are you using? Is it [version_no] V8.0 or V8.1?

A new question from [user_name] has been split into a separate thread about Windows 10 and [product_name] – specifically issues with downloading and uploading programs to the [product_name] module. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced connection problems after upgrading computers to Windows 10 and installing [product_name] software and hardware. Compatibility issues between the updated operating system and [company_name] equipment are affecting workflow, and users are being asked about their specific hardware models and software versions to assist with troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth and dependable communication between their Windows 10 systems and [product_name] hardware and software, without compatibility problems or connection failures.
